about: Grande Prairie is in northwestern Alberta’s Peace Country, a prairie-and-forest service city for oil, gas, and grain country west of the Alberta–British Columbia boundary. It sits on a former lakebed with Muskoseepi Park cutting a green ravine through town. Highways fan toward Dawson Creek, the Peace River, and the northern Rockies. About 64,000 people live in Grande Prairie.
